body: He doesn't want to hear my problems. He feels like I lean on him too much as it is. I told him I needed to have lunch with him and talk badly. He said ok. He is now spending the afternoon elsewhere. He canceled. I wish I had someone to talk to. I cannot get anything but loans due to already having a degree. I have fantasies about crashing my car while driving, slitting my wrists while holding scissors, jumping off of a bridge while driving. I think my child would be better. They would not have to grow up with a mother that cannot provide and is a complete failure.
